objective: Independently train Wiener and Restormer on mixed real handmade/MIDV pairs; measure real before/after CER and registered-reference SSIM.
data: 90 reviewed pairs: 58 train, 18 validation, 14 test; handmade side splits at user request; existing MIDV card splits; provisional handmade text.

wiener.shortlist: Union of six lowest training CER and six highest training SSIM candidates, plus prior real-MIDV radius4/K0.3; original baseline.

selection: Equal mean of handmade and MIDV pooled CER; equal mean of their image-mean SSIM. Prefer candidates improving both over original, then minimum CER, then maximum SSIM. If none jointly improves, choose minimum sum of CER and negative-SSIM ranks among filtering candidates, tie by CER; explicitly report failure of joint criterion. No test tuning.
test: Freeze selected Wiener parameters and Restormer checkpoint before test inference. Report pooled and separate source results, per-side/card outcomes, and reference-shift SSIM sensitivity at offsets -2,0,2 pixels.
limits: Exploratory reused benchmark, not untouched confirmatory test.
Residual alignment and reference quality constrain SSIM interpretation.
No fabricated blur added during training or evaluation.
